起始点武器库现已开启。

NETMESSAGE:Message from your team:\n\nSecurity safe keycard found.
Translation: 来自你的队伍的消息：\n\n找到保险柜钥匙卡。

Translation: 来自你的队伍的消息：\n\n找到清水出水口钥匙。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Someone just got om nom nom'd

NETMESSAGE:Message from your team:

Rope dropped from the car park.
Shortcut available.
Translation:
来自你的队伍的消息：

从停车场扔下了绳索。
捷径可用。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Use the rope to create a shortcut.
NETMESSAGE:You can't leave before your mission is completed!
Translation: 任务完成前你不能离开！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Those barrels look vunrable to explosives! We better be careful.
Translation: 那些桶看起来容易爆炸！我们最好小心点。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The aliens...they are backing down!\n\nLooks like we've escaped their pursuit.
Translation: 外星人……他们在退却！\n\n看来我们已经摆脱了他们的追击。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Message from your team:

Fresh water has now been cleaned.
Head to the car park to leave the sewers.
Translation:
来自你的队伍的消息：

清水现已净化完毕。
前往停车场离开下水道。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Message from your team:

The car park gate is open.
You have to kill the boss before you can leave.
Translation:
来自你队伍的消息：

停车场大门已开启。
你必须先击杀BOSS才能离开。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Message from your team:

We've reached the alien toxifiers.
Blow them up to purify the public water.
Translation:
来自你队伍的消息：

我们已抵达外星毒化器。
炸毁它们以净化公共水源。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Hey! There are some explosive charges on\ntop of those lockers.
Translation: 嘿！那些储物柜顶部有一些炸药。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Message from your team:

The alien boss is dead.
Use the truck to escape!
Translation:
来自你队伍的消息：
